# CXNM - Standard - WIN - D - Google Chrome Extensions

Blocks extensions in Google Chrome, as Microsoft Edge Extensions does in Edge.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | — |
| Source | Google Chrome policy in the settings catalog (chromeintunev1, chromeintunev141) — values chosen to match the Edge counterpart in this baseline; ids, options and ranges verified against DCv2/Settings in pl4nty/intune-change-tracking |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Google_Chrome_Extensions.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Google_Chrome_Extensions.json) |

> Separate from Google Chrome Security because this is the policy that most often needs an exception: the rest of the Chrome hardening can roll out while the extension inventory is still running.
